title: Two Jobs, One Rook
setup: Your queen eyes f8 and both rooks stack on the e-file, while Black's rook on f8 is doing all the defending by itself.
hint: One black piece is covering two entry squares at once. Ask what happens if it is only allowed to cover one.
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on f8 has two jobs: block the eighth rank and keep e8 out of reach. {{Qxf8+}} buys the first with a queen, {{Kxf8}} is forced, and now {{Re8#}} walks into the square it can no longer watch. A defender with two duties has none.
